name: reel
description: A horizontal reel of discrete moments. Scrub the track or swipe the pane; the playhead stays put and the pane lands on that moment.
avoidWhen: Do not use for peer panes (tabs), a short exclusive label list (bead, segmented-control), or continuous media time — this is moments, not a video seek bar.

ux.behaviour: The playhead sits on the current moment; that icon is bright and the neighbors recede; the pane already shows it
ux.why: You know where you are without reading a caption

ux.behaviour: The bar is a 48 dp hit target; a tapped marker uses pressScale
ux.why: You grab the track, not a 2 dp line
ux.reducedMotion: The marker does not scale; the tap still selects

ux.behaviour: The playhead stays; the reel snaps; the pane slides to the moment; each index change fires a tick haptic
ux.why: The place you landed should be felt before it is read
ux.reducedMotion: The reel and pane jump to the moment; haptics unchanged

ux.behaviour: Flinging past the ends meets a wall; there is no reject haptic
ux.why: The end of the reel is a stop, not a scolding

ux.behaviour: Reversing mid-scrub retargets to the new nearest moment and the pane follows
ux.why: You are steering, not committing a form
Rotation and the back stack keep the moment

aiHints: Own selectedIndex; do not store it inside AppReel
Keep 2–7 moments; more is a list or tabs plus a pager
Pass an icon and a label on every moment — the label is TalkBack and the pane announcement
This is discrete moments, not a duration or thumbnail filmstrip
Do not use for peer panes; those are tabs
